claim: ULA contention changes beeper edge durations even with equal clock, instructions and R; bound the difference, keep a contention-off diagnostic, and never claim byte-identical waveforms.

evidence.text: Original-clock beeper proof: 5,650 pulses equal in register/R/FE sequences; ULA contention phase bounds edge-time differences (aggregate below 0.011%); contention-off diagnostic gives exact edges.
